title: Mattermost versions 11.11.x <= 11.11.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 fail to check whether the calling…
description: Certain versions of Mattermost (11.11.x up to 11.11.0, 11.7.x up to 11.7.11, and 11.10.x up to 11.10.2) do not properly verify if a session originated from an OAuth authorization grant. This flaw allows a third-party application with a delegated access token to register a new OAuth application impersonating the delegating user via the OAuth application registration endpoint.
